name: Asset Holding
definition: Specifies in terms of value and quantity the assets.

HoldingValue.name: Holding Value
HoldingValue.definition: Value of the balance of an individual securities holding.

BookValue.name: Book Value
BookValue.definition: Value of a security, as booked/acquired in an account. Book value is often different from the current market value of the security.

FaceAmount.name: Face Amount
FaceAmount.definition: Quantity expressed as an amount representing the face amount, ie, the principal, of a debt instrument.

AmortisedFaceValue.name: Amortised Face Value
AmortisedFaceValue.definition: Quantity expressed as an amount representing the current amortised face amount of a bond, for example, a periodic reduction/increase of a bond's principal amount.

MarketValue.name: Market Value
MarketValue.definition: Value of the asset holding based on current market prices.

UnrealisedGainOrLoss.name: Unrealised Gain Or Loss
UnrealisedGainOrLoss.definition: Difference between the holding value and the book value of the asset.

EligibleCollateralValue.name: Eligible Collateral Value
EligibleCollateralValue.definition: Value of the position eligible for collateral purposes. This corresponds to the sub balance with a type AvailableForCollateral.

CapValue.name: Cap Value
CapValue.definition: Maximum notional value for a financial instrument that is capped.

RiskAdjustedValue.name: Risk Adjusted Value
RiskAdjustedValue.definition: Value of the asset holding after deduction of a percentage (the haircut) that reflects the perceived risk associated with holding this asset.

RealisedGainOrLoss.name: Realised Gain Or Loss
RealisedGainOrLoss.definition: Difference between the realised value caused by the actual trade/re-evaluation and the book value of the asset.

UnrealisedType.name: Unrealised Type
UnrealisedType.definition: Specifies whether the unrealised amount is a gain or a loss.

PostHaircutValue.name: Post Haircut Value
PostHaircutValue.definition: Value of the collateral after deduction of a percentage (the haircut) that reflects the perceived risk associated with holding this collateral.

Balance.name: Balance
Balance.definition: Specifies the balance of the asset holding.

Asset.name: Asset
Asset.definition: Specifies the asset included in the holding.

Haircut.name: Haircut
Haircut.definition: Percentage by which an asset's market value is reduced for the purpose of calculating capital requirement, margin and collateral levels.

ExchangeRate.name: Exchange Rate
ExchangeRate.definition: Specifies the exchange rate between the currency of the asset and the reporting currency.

Interest.name: Interest
Interest.definition: interest relative to the asset and the parameters used to calculate it.

Collateral.name: Collateral
Collateral.definition: Specifies the collateral information in relation with some assets.

VariationMarginCollateral.name: Variation Margin Collateral
VariationMarginCollateral.definition: Specifies the collateral information in relation with the segregated independent amount asset holding.

IndependentAmountCollateral.name: Independent Amount Collateral
IndependentAmountCollateral.definition: Specifies the collateral information in relation with the segregated independent amount asset holding.
